name: Microgrid generator spinning-reserve contribution
summary: Identifies the declared usable additional output of a connected generating set.
description: Identifies the declared usable additional output of a connected generating set. Generating-set coordination decides which available machines should operate and how their power contribution is shared. Engine starting, breaker connection, load acceptance and stopping are separate stages with their own feedback.

In a microgrid power station, the controller can request an additional generator when available reserve falls and later unload a selected machine before its documented stop sequence. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Generator output and available limit” at the input and “Assigned reserve contribution” at the output. Response capability and operating constraints matter.

Preserve the engine and generator electrical boundaries, command authority and source readiness. Starting duty, minimum loading, synchronising, fuel systems and cooling behavior require the selected generator documentation. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
